# 107 deterministic mode: measurements (generated by analyse.py)

## Level 1: identical-output rate at temperature 0 (OpenRouter)

Pre-registered in `preregistration.md` (model 1); the second model was added after seeing the first (amendment in that file).
Identical-output rate of a prompt = the share of its calls whose reply equals the most common reply. Each prompt was sent 10 times.

| model | arm | mean identical-output rate | prompts with 10 of 10 identical | rate per prompt (5 prompts) | providers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| openai/gpt-6-luna | A_temperature0_seed | 0.46 | 1 of 5 | 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, 0.9, 1.0 | OpenAI 50 |
| openai/gpt-6-luna | B_temperature0.2_default | 0.44 | 1 of 5 | 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0 | OpenAI 50 |
| openai/gpt-6-luna | (calls that failed twice and were excluded) | 0 | | | |
| deepseek/deepseek-chat | A_temperature0_seed | 0.227 | 0 of 5 | 0.5, 0.111, 0.2, 0.125, 0.2 | DeepInfra 5, StreamLake 37 |
| deepseek/deepseek-chat | B_temperature0.2_default | 0.195 | 0 of 5 | 0.333, 0.143, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3 | DeepInfra 8, StreamLake 38 |
| deepseek/deepseek-chat | (calls that failed twice and were excluded) | 12 | | | |

## Level 2: a recorded run and its replay (scripted T1 episode through the whole stage graph)

- Recorded run: 24 model calls, 42 tool calls dispatched by the core, 16 files written by the model.
- Replay with no model client: served 24 calls from the tape, live calls 0, misses 0, unused recordings 0.
- Same tool calls (SHA-256 equal): True; same files written (SHA-256 equal): True; exact: True.
- Level recorded in the replay run's `config.json`: 2 (replay: every model call served from a recorded tape (exact)).

## Plan repeatability (brief 106's score) on the record and its replay

- Stage plan: 1 of 1 pairs equal (rate 1.0); full visit sequence: 1 of 1 (rate 1.0). The episode includes a rewind, so the sequence is not a straight line.
- For contrast, brief 106 measured the full visit sequence equal in 6 of 14 pairs across live runs of the same request (`results/106_orchestrator/results.md`).
